operations.name: Milo Billman

expected.name: Milo Billman
expected.description: Rev. Milo Billman, a Lutheran minister ordained in 1958, was the only Protestant clergyman among the Camden 28. He had worked with Appalachian communities near Cincinnati, helped develop an antipoverty organization in Columbus, and served as outreach director of Camden's EPOC program. He was severed from the main trial and his charges were dismissed after the May 1973 acquittals.

operations.source: Primary FBI interview at NARA identifies Reverend Milo Marion Billman, born April 20, 1932, Sharon Center Ohio: https://www.archives.gov/files/research/jfk/releases/2022/docid-32989529.pdf . Independently corroborated by family obituary reproduction: https://www.genlookups.com/mn/webbbs_config.pl/noframes/read/1687 . Same 1932 year retained and approximate birthday refined. No death day assigned from adjacent obituary of Hilary Jozwick.
